verdict.rationale: Relay documents event-triggered rules for money movement: auto-transfer on every deposit, splitting by dollar amount or percentage, sweeping excess cash to savings, and multi-step approval rules for payments. Community evidence confirms automatic partitioning works but says external payments still need manual execution, so automation is limited to a fixed set of transfer and approval rule types. Missing for 10: a general-purpose trigger/action rule builder beyond transfers and approvals, automated external payment actions, webhooks or API-driven event automation, and detailed docs on rule configuration and trigger conditions.
